messages:
marta: Quick RFC follow-up: we need a concrete plan for how the validator mesh decides routing for model admissions. Tradeoffs between a single control router and per-prober routing came up.

devin: Single router makes dedupe and global metrics trivial, but it's a single logical choke and increases HA complexity.

alyssa: Per-prober routing scales better. Concern: duplicate expensive benches across probers. We should avoid running the same golden bench twice.

marta: Proposal: keep distributed routing but add a tiny coordination "golden lease" service. Probers attempt to acquire a lease for model_id; winner runs the canonical golden bench.

sam: Love the lease idea. Make behavior optimistic: if a prober can't get a lease quickly, it can run a provisional local probe and mark those results provisional until golden completes.

kevin: Lease TTL ops question: avoid long-held leases. Recommend default 30s with exponential backoff jitter on retries.

alyssa: Also need routing awareness of model footprint. Suggest routing keys include max_seq and estimated_param_bin so we send heavy models to large-GPU pools.

marta: Agreed. Routing keys: model_id, max_seq, param_bin. Deterministic mapping of param_bin -> shard pool.

devin: Compatibility checks: runtime ABI (kv shape, past-kv layout) must be matched. We can add an abi_hash into the model fingerprint and have pools advertise supported_abis.

sam: We already compute fingerprints; extend them: fingerprint.abi_hash. Router matches by set intersection: if fingerprint.abi_hash in pool.supported_abis then OK.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Note: router config change will trigger canary autoscaler 10->50. Coordinate with eng-infra.

marta: We'll gate the rollout behind a canary and manual infra signoff.

kevin: Bench-side dedupe: short-lived bench_cache keyed by (model_id, bench_profile) TTL 5m + jitter to avoid stampedes.

alyssa: bench_profile must include model_binary_digest and quantization_tag so different builds aren't collapsed.

devin: Fallback: if no compatible pool found, router should schedule a fast CPU smoke simulation and mark the model "needs_full_bench" so owners get quick fail/pass signal.

marta: And route smoke runs to a high-priority queue so owners get feedback quickly (<2min) rather than waiting behind heavy benches.

sam: UX: owners get admit report link immediately. Report shows status: provisional / golden / failed and basic perf numbers. Keep URL pattern /models/<id>/admit-report.

kevin: Implementation sketch:\nrouter.match_keys = ["model_id","max_seq","param_bin","abi_hash"]\nlease_service.acquire(model_id, role="golden", ttl=30s)\nbench_cache.set((model_id,bench_profile),result,ttl=300s)

alyssa: Testing: unit tests for key derivation, integration with three shard pools (small/med/large), and chaos test where lease service injects latency.

marta: Action items:\n- devin: prototype lease service + API doc (EOW)\n- sam: bench cache PR with TTL and jitter config (Wed)\n- alyssa: integration test matrix + smoke-run harness (Fri)\n- kevin: sync with eng-infra on canary plan (tomorrow)

devin: I'll draft a short design note with API semantics after this thread.

marta: If no objections I'll open a concise RFC follow-up capturing these decisions and a rollout checklist.

alyssa: No objections. :+1:

sam: SGTM.

kevin: Sounds good.

marta: Closing loop. Ping here if infra-bot flags the canary during rollout.
